title: INSPECT REPLACING CHARACTERS BY — single-pass character substitution; non-idempotent on chains
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SCRUB-NUL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-LINE    PIC X(80).
      *> INSPECT REPLACING CHARACTERS BY ' ' scans left-to-right and
      *> replaces every LOW-VALUE byte (0x00) with a space. Single
      *> pass: chaining REPLACING does NOT loop. A Java port using
      *> String.replace works for simple cases; for CHARACTERS BY...
      *> WHEN... the rewrite needs a state machine.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           INSPECT WS-LINE REPLACING ALL LOW-VALUE BY ' '.
           STOP RUN.
notes: INSPECT REPLACING with LOW-VALUE is common in mainframe-cleanup code that scrubs null bytes from inter-system data. A simple String.replace works; if multiple REPLACING clauses are chained their order matters and the spec must capture it.
